rationale: Base rate for a major AAA release staying on its announced date within 12 days of launch is high. Rockstar's own announcement set Nov 19, 2026, and as of Nov 5-7 neither Rockstar nor Take-Two had announced a new delay, with a launch trailer and gallery repeating the date. The game was delayed twice before, so a residual risk remains, and Take-Two's Nov 9 earnings call is the main near-term point of risk.

The 2024 North American eclipse peaked at about 1.46M on NASA's aggregate count, and the 2026 path is mostly over Iceland, Spain and the Atlantic, with a 1:15 pm EDT start that is evening in Europe. Search found NASA streamed the broadcast on NASA+, YouTube and social channels, but no published peak viewer figure. Exceeding 2M would need a notably bigger audience than 2024, so I put it below even odds.

Status quo: Microsoft 365 and Office are ongoing commercial products with no sign of discontinuation, so being active on Nov 10, 2026 is near certain. I did not run a search because the status-quo base rate is overwhelming and the question is only about activity over a few days.

Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 on Oct 26, 2026 with the share count, price range and prospectus date still blank, and the ticker ANT has been applied for on Nasdaq. The earliest roadshow under the SEC 15-day rule is about Nov 10, so listing by Nov 20 would need an amended S-1 with a price range and a very compressed roadshow. No such amendment was found as of Nov 7, so I give a low but real chance.

India's environment minister said on Nov 3, 2026 that India will not sign any pledge, and the US has withdrawn from the agreement and is sending no official delegation. No official Chinese position on the 35-by-35 electrification pledge was found. A Chinese sign-on at COP31 remains possible but is unsupported by evidence, so the probability stays low.

The nuclear-strike claim rests on an unnamed source relayed by Tucker Carlson, and the White House and Rubio have said no final decision has been made on resuming strikes. Nuclear experts quoted by The War Zone consider a nuclear strike on Pickaxe Mountain highly unlikely, and Trump reportedly ruled out nuclear use against Iran last month. Such an event would be a major, widely reported step, so the 4-10 November window warrants a very low probability.

The Tobacco Taxation Directive requires unanimity, and a preview said nicotine pouch rates, traditional tobacco and minimum excise were still disputed, with Swedish and Spanish reservations. Presidency drafts show compromise texts that include nicotine pouches and e-liquid rates, and the meeting was aimed at a compromise. I could not confirm the outcome of the Nov 9 meeting, and a confirmed inclusion of vapes and pouches is plausible but uncertain.

Same underlying event as the Manifold version: the public S-1 was filed Oct 26, 2026 with blanks for price and share count, and no amended filing with a price range had been found by Nov 7. A listing and first trade by Nov 20 would require a very fast roadshow starting around Nov 10. I give it a low probability, consistent with the other Anthropic IPO question.

Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on Oct 28, 2026, but access is limited to U.S. government pre-release testers and a subset of cyber defenders in the Fairwind program, with no public date. Argon went from Fairwind to general access in about 13 days, so a public Carbon release in the Nov 9-15 window is possible, but Google has only said it will come soon. The question also requires the model to be named Carbon or confirmed as the same model.

This version resolves YES if Rockstar releases GTA 6 on or before Nov 19, so an early launch also counts. The date is Rockstar's current official date, with no delay announced as of Nov 5-7 and preload and launch marketing active. The residual risk is a last-minute delay, mainly around Take-Two's Nov 9 results.

The US lifted its blockade of Iranian ports in June 2026 under a memorandum, but the deal collapsed and the US reimposed the blockade in July. As of Nov 6-7, Iran says Hormuz stays closed until the US meets seven conditions, starting with ending the blockade, and Qatar-mediated talks are ongoing, with Trump describing talks as active. A qualifying official, unambiguous announcement of a general end by Nov 15 is possible given the June precedent, but no such announcement was found.

As of early November 2026 T Coronae Borealis had not erupted, and several past forecast windows, including one ending in Sept 2026, have lapsed. The window here is only about four days (to Nov 11, 00:00 ET), and an eruption would need to occur in that window and reach magnitude 5. A base rate of a few percent per week for an imminent-but-undated outburst supports a low probability.
